HUD protocol and terminal core adapted from milestone-7/src/cluster/hudterm.hpp,
hud_terminal.hpp/.cpp and src/most/{ids,msg,registry}.hpp in the local authorized
Supra-iDrive6-Android-Auto source copy. The runtime Client/HudTerminal wrapper
was omitted; the retained Core uses a new DSI adapter, CDS feed and MOST boost.

The HUD adapter and profile still require parked validation on this vehicle.
